description: OBJECT-COMPUTER clauses WITHOUT computer-name-1 — ISO §2023:12.3.6.2 makes computer-name-1 optional and lets the clauses (PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE, CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION) follow the paragraph's period directly. X3.23-1985 hung the clauses (MEMORY SIZE, PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE, SEGMENT-LIMIT) off a REQUIRED computer-name, so the name-less clause form is a 2002 relaxation; the empty paragraph (and SOURCE-COMPUTER's, §2023:12.3.5.2) was legal at 85 already. Parsed at every edition (superset-parse / bind-narrow) so the below-2002 rejection is this named gate rather than `unexpected 'PROGRAM'`. kb/Work PB78.
citation: ISO §2023:12.3.6.2 (OBJECT-COMPUTER: [computer-name-1] before the clause set) — 2002 relaxation of the '85 required-name format
vcr: 2002 relaxation: computer-name-1 optional in SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER, and the OBJECT-COMPUTER clauses may stand without it (§2023:12.3.5.2 / §2023:12.3.6.2; the '85 formats required the name before any clause)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. CNOPT.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
OBJECT-COMPUTER.
    PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS AL.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    ALPHABET AL IS STANDARD-1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A PIC X VALUE "a".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    IF A > "B" DISPLAY "GT" ELSE DISPLAY "LE" END-IF.
    STOP RUN.
